localBiteReport: The most current inshore report with Choctawhatchee Bay / Destin-area detail is from the week of September 18–24, 2026. Capt. Adam Schroeder (Ignite The Bite Charters, Destin) described the inshore bite as one of the best he had seen all year, with redfish — both slot fish and bull reds — leading the action around bridges and structure on an outgoing tide, while flounder and speckled trout were also actively feeding as abundant bait made them easy to find early in the morning. Water temp at this location is 85°F. An earlier report from September 4–10 noted Choctawhatchee Bay was already showing early fall transition signs, with baitfish pushing from open water into bayous, flats, and bridge areas and redfish activity on the flats expected to improve as September moved toward October. Live bait — scaled sardines, shrimp, and croakers — has been the dominant approach for reds, while the bridges (Brooks Bridge, Destin Bridge) and deeper docks are holding structure-oriented fish including flounder.
